Hi, I'm Dr. Doug Willen and I'm an animal chiropractor!

You may know me from my other Chiropractic Channel: "House of Chiro" where I work on humans in New York City. If you like shows like All Creatures Great and Small, you may like watching Animal Cracker as I work with animals in a different way. I post videos of my work with all types of animals; dogs, horses, pigs, chickens, cats, rabbits, cows, goats, and more.

Please Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCyzGslwGeHYbXiMefePIbPw?sub_confirmation=1
Follow me on Instagram and TikTok: @dr.doug_animalcracker

Sleep Apnea and Snoring Transformation "Gym": https://www.skool.com/exhalemethod/about

Free Masterclass: The Hidden Link Between Snoring, Mouth Breathing & Sleep Apnea
If you snore, mouth breathe, wake up tired, or rely on CPAP, this class is for you!

👉 Watch the full masterclass here:
https://drdougwillen.easywebinar.live/ExhaleMethod
